problem.html:
The Problem With
Next-Token Prediction
Problem.01
[01]
Long Horizon Planning

Planning and decision making in a business are long-horizoned, unconstrained and always evolving.

Problem.02
[02]
Dynamic Environment

Business ecosystems constantly shift due to market volatility, competitor actions, and macroeconomic disruptions, requiring internal models that adapt continuously in real time.

Problem.03
[03]
Inference efficiency

Running high-frequency simulations, causal reasoning, and multi-agent operations at scale demands low-latency, cost-effective architectures to support autonomous business workflows.

Autoregressive next-token prediction architectures don’t really work in a business since it is a living system of parts, processes and decisions that is only partially observable and constantly changing.

Every single decision can ripple through thousands of downstream steps across multiple departments and processes.
